_comment: P2-A billing-map: maps (provider, auth_profile) -> billing_mode. Copy to store/billing-map.json (gitignored) and fill with your real accounts. There is NO provider-name heuristic: any (provider, auth_profile) pair NOT listed here resolves to 'unknown' (never a false 'free'). Valid billing_mode values: subscription_included | subscription_credit | api_payg | local_compute | unknown. These entries are ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders, not real account data.
